algorithm: Apply frozen Stage-C realizability theorem; if unrealizable, MU=0.
If N_T=0, realizable iff s=t and then MU=1.
If N_T>0 and realizable, set r=t for s!=t and r=s for s=t.
Compute token-level TAU_r(T) by the finite multiplicity-weighted parent-map sum.
scope_guard: Positive formula is invoked only after Stage-C realizability and N_T>0, so every active non-root has d_x>=1 and no (-1)! occurs.
zero_transition: T=0: MU=1 iff s=t; otherwise MU=0.
